items.criterion: One invitation message reaches the invited address and no other address holds a copy.
items.judgment: Read the mail server inbox for the invited address and for every seeded account.

items.criterion: One handover message reaches the lead of the receiving team and no other address holds a copy.
items.judgment: Read the mail server inbox for the team lead and for the other seeded accounts.

items.criterion: A teammate reading a conversation outside their teams is answered as though the record is absent.
items.judgment: Request the other team's conversation with the teammate's own token and read the status code.

items.criterion: Two claims of one unassigned conversation leave a single assignee on the stored row.
items.judgment: Issue both claims, then read the conversation row and its assignment parts.

items.criterion: A repeated send attempt under one client key appends a single part to the thread.
items.judgment: Send the same attempt twice, then count the stored parts carrying that body.

items.criterion: A second agent trigger on one customer message leaves a single run row.
items.judgment: Trigger the agent twice, then count the stored agent run rows for the conversation.

items.criterion: Publishing an article a second time stores a second version and moves the current version pointer.
items.judgment: Publish twice, then read the stored version rows for the article.

items.criterion: A conversation records the service level policy it was matched to at creation.
items.judgment: Read the seeded policy row and the conversation row that names it.

items.criterion: The resolution report answers for the reader's own reach rather than the whole workspace.
items.judgment: Read the report as a manager and as an administrator and compare the totals.

items.criterion: An ungrounded agent run writes a summary part and a handover part rather than a reply.
items.judgment: Trigger the agent on the unrouted conversation and read the stored parts.
